description: Pages when a camera has reported no motion EVENTS beyond its own staleness window while the rest of the fleet is active. REWORKED 2026-08-27. Three triggers: the onset edge; a change to the STALE SET (so an additional camera crossing its threshold raises a genuinely new card instead of silently rewriting an existing one); a boot trigger (neither the onset edge nor a set-change can fire at startup, so without it a restart-wiped card took up to the full re-assert period to return) and a slow 2-hourly re-assert purely to restore a card wiped by a restart. The re-assert used to run HOURLY, which produced 260 identical recreations against 3 real state transitions in 26 days and trained the reader to ignore the channel - behind 50 identical pages sat one genuinely broken camera and one physically misaimed one. The condition now reads the recorder-derived stale_count instead of the template entity's last_changed, so a restart no longer disarms it for the first hour. Read the page as an observation, not a verdict: under a 24/7-recording plan the camera still records to the cloud regardless. DUPLICATE PUSHES FIXED 2026-09-30: (1) onset no longer pushes - every transition that turns the binary on is also a change to the stale set that setchange already pushed, so the first camera to go stale paged twice an hour apart; onset now only re-posts the card. (2) setchange pushes only when a camera is ADDED to the stale set: a camera leaving it re-sent the remaining, already-paged cameras (4 of 10 setchange pushes in the preceding 30 days); the card still updates. proven and boot-with-proof unchanged. Known residual: a reload or a monitor error that blanks the stale set re-pages the cameras still stale when it recovers (the set reads as newly added); the previous gate pushed twice in that case. WALK-TEST HINT 2026-10-03: when a stale camera's verdict carries the ROOM SWITCH note, the push ends with how to run the walk test (the room has no co-firing partner, so the push alone must say how to check it); the push gate is unchanged. The card's corroboration header says the check reads only recorder rows (it used to say 'no walk test' directly above a note asking for one).

triggers.value_template: {% set corr = state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','corroboration') or {} %}{{ (corr.items() | selectattr('1.broken', 'defined') | selectattr('1.broken') | list | count) > 0 }}

data.title: 📷 No motion events: {% set st = state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','stale') or [] %}{{ st | join(', ') if st else 'none' }}

conditions.value_template: {% set corr = state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','corroboration') or {} %}{% set broke = corr.items() | selectattr('1.broken', 'defined') | selectattr('1.broken') | list | count %}{% set new_set = ((trigger.to_state.attributes.get('stale') if trigger.to_state is defined and trigger.to_state else none) or []) %}{% set old_set = ((trigger.from_state.attributes.get('stale') if trigger.from_state is defined and trigger.from_state else none) or []) %}{% set added = new_set | reject('in', old_set) | list %}{{ (trigger.id == 'setchange' and added | count > 0) or trigger.id == 'proven' or (trigger.id == 'boot' and broke > 0) }}

data.title: 📷 No motion events: {{ (state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','stale') or []) | join(', ') }}
data.message: {% set corr = state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','corroboration') or {} %}{% set broke = corr.items() | selectattr('1.broken','defined') | selectattr('1.broken') | map(attribute='0') | list %}{% if broke %}PROVEN event-path failure: {{ broke | join(', ') }}. {% endif %}{{ state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','summary') }}{% set st = state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','stale') or [] %}{% set wt = namespace(c=[]) %}{% for k, v in corr.items() %}{% if k in st and v is mapping and 'ROOM SWITCH' in ((v.get('verdict') or '') | string) %}{% set wt.c = wt.c + [k] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if wt.c %} | Walk test ({{ wt.c | join(', ') }}): double-tap either paddle of the room switch, then walk in.{% endif %}
